preconditions.description: The root must be an instance of TreeNode.
The value of the root node must be between 0 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in nodes)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the tree must be instances of TreeNode.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is not None for node in nodes if node.nextRight is not None)
postconditions.description: All nodes at the same level must have their nextRight pointers set correctly.
The output must be the level order traversal followed by the inorder traversal of the tree.
